about.title: About Four Star Roofing
text: Four Star Roofing is the American dream realized as Bill Mosher travelled to Houston in 1983. His family had enough money to make it through the winter or find work as a roofer in the developing suburb of Kingwood. Bill Mosher and his family were the Four Stars that built the company into one of the most successful residential roofing companies in Texas.

Four Star Roofing has been located in Kingwood, TX for over 40 years. We are a 2nd generation family business (hopefully a 3rd generation). We are not your typical roofer working out of his truck offering warranties that won’t be fulfilled. Four Star has roofed for some of the largest builders in Houston and currently holds a Factory Certified GAF Master Elite status. This means that we are among the top 3% of all roofing companies to install the #1 shingle in North America, the Timberline HD Lifetime Shingle.
